[
  {"step": 1, "file": "poc.rb", "function": "<global>", "line": 1, "var": "a", "code": "a = [1, 2, 3]", "note": "Creates a heap-allocated array with 3 elements (alen=3)."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "poc.rb", "function": "<global>", "line": 2, "var": "a[2,5]", "code": "a[2, 5] = [4, 5, 6, 7]", "note": "Calls mrb_ary_aset with head=2, len=5, and replacement array of 4 elements."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "src/array.c", "function": "mrb_ary_aset", "line": 1005, "var": "v1, v2, v3", "code": "mrb_ary_splice(mrb, self, aget_index(mrb, v1), aget_index(mrb, v2), v3)", "note": "Dispatches to mrb_ary_splice with head=2, len=5, rpl=[4,5,6,7]."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "src/array.c", "function": "mrb_ary_splice", "line": 731, "var": "alen", "code": "mrb_int alen = ARY_LEN(a);", "note": "alen=3, the current length of array a."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "src/array.c", "function": "mrb_ary_splice", "line": 744, "var": "tail", "code": "tail = head + len;", "note": "tail = 2 + 5 = 7, pointing past the end of the array."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "src/array.c", "function": "mrb_ary_splice", "line": 745, "var": "len", "code": "if (alen < len || alen < tail) { len = alen - head; }", "note": "Since alen(3) < len(5), len is clamped to alen - head = 1. CRITICAL BUG: tail is NOT recomputed and remains 7."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "src/array.c", "function": "mrb_ary_splice", "line": 750, "var": "argc", "code": "argc = RARRAY_LEN(rpl);", "note": "argc=4, the length of the replacement array [4,5,6,7]."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "src/array.c", "function": "mrb_ary_splice", "line": 786, "var": "newlen", "code": "newlen = alen + argc - len;", "note": "newlen = 3 + 4 - 1 = 6. Since head(2) < alen(3), the else branch is taken."},
  {"step": 9, "file": "src/array.c", "function": "mrb_ary_splice", "line": 803, "var": "len != argc", "code": "if (len != argc) {", "note": "len(1) != argc(4), so the value_move call is executed."},
  {"step": 10, "file": "src/array.c", "function": "mrb_ary_splice", "line": 804, "var": "value_move(ptr + head + argc, ptr + tail, alen - tail)", "code": "value_move(ptr + head + argc, ptr + tail, alen - tail);", "note": "Calls value_move(ptr+6, ptr+7, 3-7=-4). The size argument -4 is interpreted as a huge size_t, and tail=7 points past the heap allocation."},
  {"step": 11, "file": "src/value_array.h", "function": "value_move", "line": 10, "var": "n", "code": "if (n == 0) return;", "note": "n is a huge size_t (from -4), so execution continues."},
  {"step": 12, "file": "src/value_array.h", "function": "value_move", "line": 11, "var": "s1, s2", "code": "if (s1 > s2 && s1 < s2 + n)", "note": "s1=ptr+6 > s2=ptr+7 is false, so the else-if branch is taken."},
  {"step": 13, "file": "src/value_array.h", "function": "value_move", "line": 16, "var": "*s2", "code": "*s1++ = *s2++;", "note": "Reads 8 bytes from s2=ptr+7, which is 4 elements (32 bytes) past the 3-element heap allocation, causing heap-buffer-overflow (READ of size 8)."}
]
EOF
